transfection.title: Transfection Optimizer
transfection.helpText: Tune your electroporation parameters to deliver DNA into the cell efficiently without killing it. The sweet spot is the reversible-EP window.
transfection.noCellLineSelected: Select a cell line first to optimize transfection parameters.
transfection.recommendationOptimal: Your parameters land in the reversible-EP window. Expect high transfection efficiency with preserved viability.
transfection.recommendationBelow: Field strength is too low. Increase voltage or pulse width to reach the transfection window.
transfection.recommendationAbove: Field is too high. Reduce voltage or pulse width to preserve cell viability.
transfection.simulatorConstructHelp: Predictions use the Schwan equation and reversible-EP window heuristic. Validate against your bench measurements; calibration improves accuracy over time.
transfection.tipVoltage: Field strength Applied voltage divided by electrode gap (V/cm). Typical mammalian transfection range: 500 to 1500 V/cm.
transfection.tipPulseWidth: Pulse width Duration of each pulse in microseconds. Longer pulses charge the membrane closer to steady-state. Typical: 50 to 500 µs.
transfection.tipNumPulses: Number of pulses Multiple pulses reduce the effective threshold (electrosensitization). Typical: 1 to 10 pulses.
transfection.tipBuffer: Buffer conductivity Low-conductivity EP buffer (0.14 S/m typical) keeps current low and reduces Joule heating. Saline-like buffers (1.5 S/m) heat aggressively.
transfection.guidanceHelp: Host-specific best practices beyond the pulse settings: reagent ratio, culture state, and recovery.

developability.title: Developability Score
developability.helpText: Composite ranking across four production-readiness axes for your selected cell line and molecule. Use it to compare candidates side by side.
developability.noCellLineSelected: Select a cell line first to compute a developability score.
developability.simulatorConstructHelp: This composite is a platform-defined ranking aid, not a published industry standard. Weights are equal across axes.
developability.tipComposite: Composite score Equal-weighted average across the four axes. Higher is better.

strategy.title: Genetic Strategy
strategy.helpText: Recommendations based on your cell line and target molecule. Pick the primary suggestion or choose an alternative below.
strategy.noCellLineSelected: Select a cell line first to see strategy recommendations.
strategy.noAlternativesText: No alternative vectors in the catalog for this combination.
strategy.tipExpressionMode: Expression mode Transient: DNA delivered as plasmid, expression for days. Fast for screening. Stable: DNA integrated into genome, sustained expression. Required for commercial scale.
strategy.tipCodonOptimization: Codon optimization Replaces synonymous codons in your gene to match the host's preferred tRNA pool. Can boost expression 2-10x in non-mammalian systems.
